In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
EDU prevents O3-induced oxidative stress in snapbeans by acting upstream of the O3-ROS pathway.
EDU is a very efficient chemical for protecting snapbeans against O3 damage.
EDU protects snapbean plants from O3-induced oxidative stress, by acting as an antioxidant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antioxidant enzyme genes in EDU-treated O3-exposed snapbeans were not up-regulated and the antioxidant enzymes activities remained similar to the control plants.
EDU protects against ozone-induced injury by preventing the generation of reactive oxygen species.
EDU is able to protect snapbeans from O3 damage by preventing the accumulation of H2O2, which is the main signal for triggering O3-induced oxidative stress.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EDU is able to prevent the O3-induced oxidative stress in snapbeans by acting upstream of the antioxidant enzymes and H2O2.
the protective mechanism of EDU against O3-induced oxidative stress is not associated with increased antioxidant capacity.
the antioxidant enzymes measured in snapbeans are not the key targets for the protective effect of EDU.
